fact: A World Bank mission of 10-19 February 2025 agreed to hire an integration specialist, funded by the ID4D Trust Fund, to integrate the UBR with the National Registration and Identification System and the payment gateway through the new Bomalathu data exchange platform.
title: Digital Malawi Acceleration Project (DMAP, P505095): Aide-Memoire, ID Technical Discussions Mission, February 10 to 19, 2025
